| Field | Type | Base | Flags | Default | Mutability | Values and limits | Declared in | Summary |

| `publisher` | base `string` | string |  |  | content |  | `nas:Book` | Publishing house. |
| `retrieved_at` | base `date` | date |  |  | operational |  | `nas:Source` | When the source was last retrieved. |
| `title` | base `string` | string | required, label |  | content |  | `nas:Source` | Title of the source. |

## `nas:Note`

A short piece of writing about one or more topics.

Fields:

| Field | Type | Base | Flags | Default | Mutability | Values and limits | Declared in | Summary |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `body` | base `text` | text | required |  | content |  | `nas:Note` | Text of the note. |
| `kind` | enum `nas:NoteKind` | string | required |  | content | one of `observation`, `summary`, `question` | `nas:Note` | What the note records. |
| `status` | lifecycle `nas:NoteLifecycle` | string | required |  | lifecycle |  | `nas:Note` | Editorial state. |
| `title` | base `string` | string | required, label |  | content |  | `nas:Note` | Headline of the note. |

Lifecycle `status` (`nas:NoteLifecycle`): Editorial state of a note.

- State `draft` (initial): Being written.
- State `published`: Visible and citable.
- State `archived` (terminal): Kept for history only.
- `draft` -> `published`: guard `nas.body_not_empty`: A note needs a body before it is published.
- `published` -> `draft`
- `draft` -> `archived`
- `published` -> `archived`

Relations out:

| Relation | To | Cardinality | Inverse | Qualifiers | Summary |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `nas:about` | `nas:Topic` | 1..n | `has_note` |  | The note is about the topic. |
| `nas:asserts` | `provenance:Claim` | 0..n | `asserted_in` |  | The note asserts the claim. |
| `nas:cites` | `nas:Source` | 0..n | `cited_by` | `locator` | The note uses information from the source. |

Rules:

| Rule | Severity | When | Summary |
|---|---|---|---|
| `nas.summary_cites_source` | error | write | A published summary note cites at least one source. |

## `provenance:Claim`

A statement asserted to be true, recorded separately from what asserts it.

Validity in time uses the system fields valid_from and valid_to of the claim's revisions.

Fields:

| Field | Type | Base | Flags | Default | Mutability | Values and limits | Declared in | Summary |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `confidence` | enum `provenance:Confidence` | string |  |  | content | one of `low`, `medium`, `high` | `provenance:Claim` | How strongly the claim is believed. |
| `statement` | base `text` | text | required |  | content |  | `provenance:Claim` | The asserted statement in plain language. |

Relations out:

| Relation | To | Cardinality | Inverse | Qualifiers | Summary |

| `provenance:contradicts` | `provenance:Claim` | 0..n | `contradicted_by` |  | The claim cannot be true together with the target claim. |
| `provenance:supported_by` | any | 0..n | `supports` |  | Evidence that supports the claim. |

Relations in:

| Relation | From | Cardinality in | Inverse | Summary |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `nas:asserts` | `nas:Note` | 0..n | `asserted_in` | The note asserts the claim. |
